A held flock returns WouldBlock/AttachLockHeld before either new metadata call, and is not retried inside this call.
- The actual for0..ATTACH_LOCK_REOPENS with value3 permits THREE TOTAL open/flock attempts, hence at most TWO reopens. This is below the wording's 'up to3 reopens', not initial+3. Only a successful flock followed by inode mismatch or a vanished pathname retries. Other errors immediately return. At most6 added metadata syscalls per take; every mismatch drops the old File/lock before reopening. No sleeping, process or unbounded retry loop here.
